items.title: SK Hynix to List on NASDAQ in $29B ADR, Largest Foreign IPO in US History
items.title_zh: SK海力士本周五登陆纳斯达克，290亿美元ADR创外资企业史上最大规模
items.summary: SK Hynix will list approximately $29 billion in ADR on NASDAQ on July 10, making it the largest foreign-company IPO in U.S. stock market history. The listing grants access to NASDAQ 100 index inclusion. In the same 36kr daily roundup: UBTECH responded to consumer robot battery concerns; Huawei Mate 90 rumored with a new Kirin chip based on Taolu architecture.

items.title: 揭秘字节 Seedance：全球 AI 的第二个好生意 (Inside ByteDance’s Seedance: AI’s Second Big Business)
items.title_zh: 揭秘字节 Seedance：全球 AI 的第二个好生意
items.summary: 36氪独家深度报道了字节跳动Seed团队视频生成模型Seedance从内部孵化到决策的全过程。模型负责人曾妍在2025年底坚持推动训练200B参数大尺寸模型，最终获得资源支持，成为全球AI视频生成领域的第二个现象级商业产品。

items.title: Simplexity Robotics: 11-Month-Old Embodied AI Startup Ships 100 Robots to Production Lines
items.title_zh: 成立11个月的具身智能初创公司Simplexity向产线交付100台机器人
items.summary: Simplexity Robotics, an embodied AI startup founded less than a year ago, announced it has delivered the first batch of 100 units of its all-scenario robot i7 Pro to production lines, marking rapid commercialization in the humanoid robotics space.

items.title: OpenClaw Tops GitHub at 252K Stars, Surpassing Meta’s React as #1 Open-Source Project
items.title_zh: OpenClaw以25.2万星标登顶GitHub开源项目历史第一，超越React
items.summary: OpenClaw以25.2万GitHub星标超越Meta的React，登顶GitHub开源项目历史排行榜第一，成为2026年最现象级的AI Agent产品。官方发文嘲讽Meta「我们在迭代创新，而你只在办会议」。

items.title: Ant Group’s LingBot-Vision Claims 12 World Firsts: 1.1B Parameter Model Beats 7B DINOv3
items.title_zh: 蚂蚁集团LingBot-Vision拿下12项世界第一：11亿参数模型击败70亿参数DINOv3
items.summary: Ant Group’s LingBot-Depth 2.0 spatial perception model achieves 12 world-first benchmarks, with its 1.1B parameter LingBot-Vision foundation model reportedly surpassing Meta’s 7B DINOv3 on key metrics.

items.title: World’s First Neurodynamic Chip Matches Brain Speed: Peking University Breakthrough in Science
items.title_zh: 全球首个神经动力学芯片：北京大学相变忆阻器芯片达大脑速度，发表于Science
items.summary: A Peking University team unveiled the world’s first phase-change memristor neural dynamical system chip, achieving 2.12ms step latency and up to 478x speedup over NVIDIA A100 for brain modeling tasks, published in Science.

items.title: system_prompts_leaks: Extracted System Prompts from Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, and More
items.title_zh: 系统提示词泄露：提取了Claude、GPT、Gemini、Grok等多款AI产品的系统提示词
items.summary: A GitHub trending repository collects extracted system prompts from major AI products including Anthropic Claude Fable 5 & Opus 4.8, OpenAI ChatGPT 5.5 & Codex, Google Gemini 3.5 Flash, xAI Grok, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, and Perplexity, updated regularly.

items.title: The First American Autonomous Ground Vehicles Are Fighting in Ukraine
items.title_zh: 首批美国自主地面作战车辆正在乌克兰投入战斗
items.summary: Forterra has deployed more than 100 autonomous ground vehicles in Ukraine, marking the first operational use of American autonomous ground combat vehicles in active warfare.

items.title: Microsoft Can Track Users via a Windows Device ID, Hacker’s Arrest Reveals
items.title_zh: 黑客被捕事件揭示微软可通过Windows设备ID追踪用户
items.summary: Court documents from a hacker’s arrest reportedly reveal that Microsoft can track individual users through Windows device identifiers, raising privacy concerns about the operating system’s telemetry capabilities.

items.title: YC CEO Says He Ships 37K LoC AI Code Per Day; Developer Investigates the Claims
items.title_zh: YC CEO声称每天用AI产出3.7万行代码，有开发者深入核实其说法
items.summary: Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan claimed on social media that he ships 37,000 lines of code per day using AI tools. A developer analyzed the repositories in question and reported discrepancies in the claims, sparking debate about AI coding productivity metrics.

items.title: 上科大博士团队加速国产超高速光电探测芯片量产，获千万级天使轮融资 (ShanghaiTech PhD Team Secures Angel Round for Photodetector Chip)
items.title_zh: 上科大博士团队加速国产超高速光电探测芯片量产，获千万级天使轮融资
items.summary: 上海快粼光电科技完成数千万元天使轮融资，由小苗朗程领投、一村资本跟投。公司专注于III-V族高速光电探测芯片研发，曾在AI光互联与6G通信核心光芯片领域刷新世界纪录，填补国内超高速收端光芯片空白。

items.title: China’s AIFU Semiconductor Targets 1 Billion BAW Filter Chips Annually, Breaking Overseas Monopoly
items.title_zh: 中国爱孚半导体年产10亿颗BAW滤波芯片，打破海外垄断
items.summary: Guangzhou-based AIFU Semiconductor ramps BAW filter chip production to 1 billion units annually using proprietary single-crystal aluminum nitride technology, challenging Broadcom and Qorvo’s 5G RF filter monopoly.

items.title: 前大疆员工做了款消费级纺织机，拿下红杉、顺为、米哈游等数亿融资 (Ex-DJI Engineer’s Consumer Textile Machine Startup Raises Millions)
items.title_zh: 前大疆员工做了款消费级纺织机，拿下红杉、顺为、米哈游等数亿融资
items.summary: 前大疆工程师胡文鑫创立的浪爪智能（CLAWLAB）获得红杉、顺为资本、米哈游等机构数亿元融资，押注家用纺织机这一冷门硬件赛道。团队自2022年底成立以来保持低调。

items.title: Embodied AI’s Spatial Vision Breakthrough: CMG LionRock Lab Accepted at IROS 2026
items.title_zh: 具身智能空间视觉瓶颈被突破：招商局狮岩AI实验室获IROS 2026收录
items.organization: China Merchants Group / LionRock AI Lab
items.summary: China Merchants Group’s LionRock AI Lab identified and addressed VLA shortcut learning through Hybrid Dynamic Data Collection, with the work accepted at IROS 2026.

items.title: 网传新车智驾芯片自主化率不低于70%系谣言，工信部辟谣 (MIIT Debunks Rumor of Mandatory 70% Car AI Chip Self-Sufficiency)
items.title_zh: 网传新车智驾芯片自主化率不低于70%系谣言，工信部辟谣
items.summary: 近日网传《新能源汽车车规级AI芯片技术规范》要求智驾芯片自主化率不低于70%，经工业和信息化部核查，从未发布过该文件，也从未就新能源车芯片技术自主化率作出规定。

items.title: openai/codex-plugin-cc: Use Codex from Claude Code
items.title_zh: codex-plugin-cc：在Claude Code中使用OpenAI Codex进行代码审查和任务委派
items.summary: OpenAI’s official plugin enabling Claude Code users to delegate tasks to Codex for code review and task delegation, bridging the two competing coding agent ecosystems.

items.title: bradautomates/claude-video: Give Claude the Ability to Watch Any Video
items.title_zh: claude-video：让Claude能够观看任何视频的工具
items.summary: A Python tool that downloads videos, extracts frames, transcribes audio, and hands all data to Claude for analysis, effectively giving the AI the ability to watch and understand any video content.

items.title: ELiTeFormer: An Efficient Transformer for FPGAs
items.title_zh: ELiTeFormer：面向FPGA的高效Transformer架构
items.summary: NVIDIA researchers propose ELiTeFormer, a Transformer variant designed for efficient FPGA deployment that addresses the computational and memory challenges of running LLMs on resource-constrained hardware.

items.title: From Fixed to Free Cameras: Calibration-Free View-Robust Vision-Language-Action Model
items.title_zh: 从固定到自由相机：无需标定的视角鲁棒视觉-语言-动作模型
items.summary: Alibaba researchers address a key deployment challenge for VLA models in robotics: real-world camera repositioning. Their calibration-free approach enables VLA policies to remain robust when cameras are moved or remounted after training.

items.title: Multiplayer Interactive World Models with Representation Autoencoders
items.title_zh: 基于表征自编码器的多人交互世界模型
items.summary: NVIDIA introduces the first multiplayer world model for highly dynamic environments with complex physical interactions, where multiple agents interact rather than being treated as environment noise.

items.title: LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework
items.title_zh: LLM-as-a-Verifier：通用验证框架
items.summary: Researchers propose a framework using LLMs as general-purpose verifiers, identifying verification as a key capability alongside pre-training, post-training, and test-time compute for improving LLM reliability.

items.title: SABLE: An NDA-Safe Closed-Loop LLM Framework for Analog Circuit Optimization in Industrial EDA Flows
items.title_zh: SABLE：面向工业EDA模拟电路优化的NDA安全闭环LLM框架
items.summary: SABLE enables LLM-driven analog circuit optimization without exposing proprietary foundry PDK content, schematics, or simulation paths to external cloud endpoints, addressing a critical barrier to LLM adoption in industrial chip design.

items.title: Cortex: A Bidirectionally Aligned Embodied Agent Framework for Long-Horizon Manipulation
items.title_zh: Cortex：面向长时域操作的双向对齐具身智能体框架
items.summary: Cortex addresses the Markovian limitation of current VLA models by introducing a hierarchical framework with bidirectional alignment, enabling embodied agents to perform long-horizon manipulation tasks beyond reactive policies.

items.title: TileLens: Efficiently Using Large-Granularity Memory Systems with Transparent Two-Dimensional Memory Layout
items.title_zh: TileLens：通过透明二维内存布局高效利用大粒度内存系统
items.summary: TileLens proposes a transparent two-dimensional memory layout for large-granularity memory systems such as HBM, HBF, and RoMe, improving bandwidth utilization for GPU-based LLM inference.

items.title: HyNoC: A Hybrid Circuit-Switch/Wormhole Network-on-Chip for Distributed VLIW Computing on FPGA
items.title_zh: HyNoC：面向FPGA分布式VLIW计算的混合电路交换/虫孔网络芯片架构
items.summary: HyNoC is an open-source hybrid Network-on-Chip combining circuit-switch path establishment with wormhole data transfer for FPGA-based distributed VLIW systems, achieving 5x throughput improvement at LLaMA 3 8B FFN scale through quadrant-isolated traffic.
